text: Jonah Lindqvist gave Ironvale Athletic the lead with a sharp finish from just 3.7 meters after a slick set-piece move that started from a free kick and included three quick passes over 12 seconds. The goal came from a neat through ball by Oskar Lindgren, perfectly timed to catch Redmond Rovers’ high press off guard. Ironvale’s deep defense and fast, vertical attacks paid off here, pushing them ahead 2-1 in this lively match[#1154] [#1156] [#1157].
